description: Autonomous Reasoning Schemas & Engineering Archetypes for PRG-T01-C03 (Async Architectures, Resilient Systems, Caching, and High-Throughput Utilities).

archetypes.name: Token Bucket Burst Rate Limiter
archetypes.coreConcept: Token Bucket algorithm for traffic shaping and burst-tolerant rate limiting. Generates tokens at a constant rate up to a max capacity; requests consume tokens atomically.
mentalModel: 1. Store capacity (maxTokens), refillRatePerSecond, currentTokens, and lastRefillTimestamp.
2. On each consume(tokensToConsume = 1) call: calculate elapsed milliseconds since lastRefillTimestamp.
3. Add newly accrued tokens: (elapsedMs / 1000) * refillRatePerSecond.
4. Clamp currentTokens to capacity, and update lastRefillTimestamp to current time.
5. If currentTokens >= tokensToConsume, decrement currentTokens and return true; otherwise return false.
archetypes.governingInvariant: currentTokens = min(capacity, currentTokens + elapsed_sec * refill_rate); allowed = (currentTokens >= cost)

cognitiveTraps.name: Timestamp Update on Rejected Request
cognitiveTraps.description: Updating lastRefillTimestamp when a request is rejected, which discards partially accumulated refill time and starves future requests.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Call consume() when empty, wait 50% of refill time, call consume() again; if timestamp was reset, refill starts from zero instead of completing.

cognitiveTraps.name: Token Capacity Overflow Neglect
cognitiveTraps.description: Failing to clamp accumulated tokens at max capacity, permitting an unbounded burst after prolonged idle periods.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Idle for 10x capacity duration, then fire burst of capacity * 2 requests; without clamp, all succeed.

realWorldDomains.description: API Gateway throttling incoming tenant HTTP requests to prevent backend saturation.
Fintech payment processing pipeline rate limiting outward webhook deliveries.
Real-time chat server limiting broadcast message volume per connected socket client.

archetypes.name: Timing-Safe Webhook HMAC Signature Verifier
archetypes.coreConcept: Cryptographic webhook authenticity verification using HMAC-SHA256, constant-time buffer comparison, and timestamp tolerance anti-replay validation.
mentalModel: 1. Extract timestamp and signature hex from webhook header (e.g., 't=1690000000,v1=abc123...').
2. Check timestamp drift: Math.abs(currentTime - timestamp) <= toleranceSeconds to thwart replay attacks.
3. Compute expected HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawPayload}` using the shared webhook secret.
4. Convert expected and provided signatures to Buffer instances of equal length.
5. Compare digests using crypto.timingSafeEqual() to prevent timing side-channel attacks.

cognitiveTraps.name: Naive String Equality Comparison
cognitiveTraps.description: Using standard JavaScript '===' comparison which terminates early on the first mismatched byte, leaking cryptographic timing clues.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Compare signatures byte by byte; standard === returns in variable execution time proportional to matching prefix length.

cognitiveTraps.name: Missing Timestamp Tolerance Validation
cognitiveTraps.description: Verifying the HMAC signature without verifying that the payload timestamp falls within the allowed validity window.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Send a valid payload from 2 days ago; without timestamp check, replayed payload is accepted.

archetypes.name: Exponential Backoff & Jittered Retry Orchestrator
archetypes.coreConcept: Resilient async operation executor handling transient failures with exponential delay scaling, random full jitter to prevent thundering herds, and selective error classification.
mentalModel: 1. Loop from attempt = 0 up to maxRetries.
2. Invoke asynchronous operation inside a try/catch block.
3. On success, return result immediately.
4. On error, verify if error is retryable (e.g., isRetryable(err) == true or HTTP status >= 500 or ECONNRESET).
5. If error is not retryable or attempt == maxRetries, throw error immediately.
6. Calculate backoff delay: min(maxDelayMs, baseDelayMs * 2^attempt) with full jitter (Math.random() * delay).
7. Sleep for calculated delay, then proceed to next attempt.
archetypes.governingInvariant: delay = min(maxDelay, baseDelay * (2 ** attempt)); actualSleep = random() * delay; retryCount <= maxRetries

cognitiveTraps.name: Unconditional 4xx Client Error Retrying
cognitiveTraps.description: Retrying non-transient client errors (e.g. 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 404 Not Found) that can never succeed on retry.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Call retryWithBackoff with a function returning HTTP 400; retrying wastes compute and locks API keys.

cognitiveTraps.name: Missing Random Jitter in Backoff Delay
cognitiveTraps.description: Using deterministic backoff delay across concurrent clients, causing periodic waves of synchronized traffic spikes.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Simulate 100 failed requests; without jitter, all 100 retry simultaneously at exact 1s, 2s, 4s marks.

archetypes.name: Bounded Concurrency Async Promise Pool
archetypes.coreConcept: Controlled concurrency task orchestrator limiting active in-flight promises to a maximum pool size K, preventing resource exhaustion while preserving item result ordering.
mentalModel: 1. Create an output results array sized equal to input tasks array.
2. Maintain an atomic index cursor tracking the next unassigned task.
3. Spawn exactly min(concurrency, tasks.length) worker loop promises.
4. Each worker loop repeatedly grabs the next task index, awaits the task fn(items[index]), and stores the result into results[index].
5. Worker exits when cursor exceeds items.length.
6. Await Promise.all(workers) and return the ordered results array.
archetypes.governingInvariant: activeWorkers <= concurrencyLimit; results.length == items.length; results[i] corresponds to items[i]

cognitiveTraps.name: Unbounded Concurrency Flood
cognitiveTraps.description: Executing Promise.all(items.map(fn)) on thousands of items, exhausting database connection pools or socket descriptors.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Pass 1,000 tasks with concurrency limit of 5; verify at no point do active promises exceed 5.

cognitiveTraps.name: Out-of-Order Result Array Corruption
cognitiveTraps.description: Pushing completed task results into a dynamic array as they finish instead of indexing by original position.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Pass tasks with varying completion durations; verify result order matches input order, not completion order.
